scope: Theorem 2.2 (Graph criterion) of the manuscript “Finite congruence lattices: characterization and undecidability” (preprints/Finite-Congruence-Lattices-Characterization-and-Undecidability-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 206 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d26d6cd6285de4f2), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 7-8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The lattice L is the full congruence lattice of a finite algebra if and only if there is an L-colored complete graph (A, d) satisfying all three conditions below. (i) If p ̸= q, then d(p, q) ̸= 0, and d(p, q) ≤ d(p, u) ∨ d(u, q) (p, q, u ∈ A). (ii) Whenever a ̸≤ b in L, there are vertices p, q with d(p, q) ≤ a and d(p, q) ̸≤ b. (iii) For every nonempty edge set S, vertices p, q satisfying d(p, q) ≤ aS lie in the same connected component of ΓS. 7 For each fixed |A|, these conditions involve only lattice inequalities, finite vertex labelings, and paths.
